snippet.title: Beat Weaver Demo Launch - featuring Red Vox
snippet.description:
Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592220/Beat_Weaver_Demo/
Sound blast your way through a mini campaign in the Beat Weaver demo including music by Red Vox and more. Mix up your playstyle with stylish and risky maneuvers while you try to keep all instruments playing at the same time. Become the ultimate remix machine and experience multi-track rhythm gaming in a completely new form. Out now on Steam!

#rhythmgame #pcgames #indiegame
